title: WorkWatch
description: A macOS utility that reads your attendance email from Apple Mail, calculates your remaining work hours, and automatically puts your Mac to sleep when the day is done. Supports a live terminal countdown, background daemon with native notifications, and a color-coded monthly attendance log.

title: Referall
description: A job referral platform built with Go, Redis, SQLite, gRPC, and Docker. It allows users to refer friends for job opportunities, track referrals, and manage their referral network.

title: pixelQR
description: A QR code service with a single POST endpoint that takes text and returns a base64-encoded PNG in a JSON response.

title: rideshare
description: An in-memory carpooling API built as a machine-coding exercise, where drivers offer seats on a route and riders book a matching ride, optionally naming a preferred vehicle model.
summary: A carpooling API where drivers offer seats and riders book them
